_help: health = wounds per level (lvl 1 - lvl 2 - lvl 3). 'talents' must match talent names in talents.json (category 'ancestry'); they are granted automatically. 'image' is optional.

ancestries.name: Human
ancestries.lore: Humans are the de facto rulers of Akudia and make up the largest part of the continent's population. Humans are adaptable and flexible, but also seem to seek out conflict again and again.

ancestries.name: Durag
ancestries.lore:
Durag are close relatives of humans who share a special bond with stone and earth. They are born from the earth and return to it when they die. Over the course of their lives, Durag take on more and more of the properties and appearance of rock, until they finally become completely unable to move, which marks the end of their life.

Durag live secluded lives, often in mountains or caves, and have a strong sense of family.

ancestries.name: Orvosa
ancestries.lore: The Orvosa were once humans who were remade in his image during the ascension of Orvos, one of the gods. Orvos enslaved his followers, and when his ascension was imminent he turned against them, hoping to keep his power and not ascend. The goddess Inferna came to the aid of the helpless Orvosa, defeated Orvos and thereby freed them from their invisible chains.

ancestries.name: Hinan
ancestries.lore:
Hinan are relatively small and extraordinarily adaptable creatures. Even in a generation or two Hinan will adapt their abilities and their looks to fit into whatever environment they find themselves in. Though they usually take on traits of animals, they can also adapt to resemble plants or even magical lifeforms.

The Hinan have a special connection to the element of essence, seemingly in tune with the world that surrounds them.

ancestries.name: Korna
ancestries.lore:
An old proverb says: "Where there is a fight, there is a Korna near". Though it is reductive, there is still some truth to it. Korna are brutish humanoids, plae skin ranging from light blue to almost grey, they are often said to be relatives of the Durag. Korna have increased adrenaline levels and are always looking like they are stressed or angry.

But there is another side to them, Korna are a fiercely loyal people, living in clans and families that span villages. Especially in the far north, where they are best suited for harsh winter conditions they reclaimed their own lands since they were driven out by the earliest human settlers on Akudia millenia ago.

ancestries.name: Half Giant
ancestries.lore: Half Giants are rare and born from strife.

ancestries.name: Gob
ancestries.lore:
To be a Gob is to be one of the court. To be a Gob means to strife for greatness and golry for your kingdom. To be a Gob is to be a knight.

Gob are humanoid frogs and are genetically coded to follow an oath. They swear these oaths on a lord or king, vowing to protect them and bring glory to the Gob kingdom while simultaneously striving for ways to become a king themselves. Mostly found in swamps or bogs these efforts often lead to disappointing results, but every once in a while a Gob escapes the swamp and begins a life of adventure.

ancestries.name: Quabut
ancestries.lore:
The Quabut are found seldom alone, as they are part of a network of mycelia taken the form of living beings. These mushroom like creatures thrive when coming together, creating a hivemind and sharing their thoughts and feelings with one another.

Quabut try to avoid civilization and only appear in a handful of pockets on Akudia.
